mission: Falsify or narrow TM4 operator-policy transfer and test marginal-value stopping on fresh owner-native pressures with elastic model budgets.
questionOrHypothesis: H1: topology-conditioned operator selection changes causal closure/utilization on fresh workloads beyond TM1-TM3. H2: an explicit decision-changing-observation stopping policy reduces needless continuation without increasing false stops.
evidenceSelection: Exact frozen Host and Runtime revisions in battlefield-v1.json; owner continuity supplied pressure only, while hidden scoring is derived from exact owner source relations and forbidden authority violations.
strongBaseline: Open high-budget read-only Agent with identical source revision, search/read surface, submission schema and generous physical evidence ceiling.
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: HP1 candidate is only an experiment-local operator policy; HP2 candidate is only an experiment-local marginal-value stopping protocol. No product/shared service is admitted.
independentOracle: Frozen hiddenOracle per workload; never included in evaluated Agent context. Scoring checks required current owner files, causal concepts and forbidden boundary violations.
developmentSplit: No tuning on accepted primary trials. Apparatus canaries are excluded and recorded separately.
holdoutSplit: H-PACKAGE and R-WININPUT are fresh natural owner pressures unused in TM1-TM3 primary campaigns; concurrent Game RF is independent evidence rather than tuning data.
invalidityConditions: owner revision missing or changed from frozen Git object
hidden oracle exposed to evaluated model
different token ceilings between same-phase treatments
transport failure without durable replicate identity
authorityBoundary: Computing performs read-only research over frozen Git. Host/Runtime remain product authorities. No Host/Runtime mutation, deployment, package split or Windows effect is authorized.
stopRule: Experiment ends after predeclared cells converge or invalidate. Individual HP2 marginal-stop trials may stop only when they cannot name an affordable observation expected to discriminate a live alternative or change the submitted causal decision.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: Negative/no-change is first-class. Terminal runners/progress are deleted after accepted closeout; compact current evidence remains only if consumed by TM4/HP conclusions.
rollbackRule: No owner mutation occurs. Computing experiment changes remain isolated until accepted; exact historical apparatus is recoverable from Git after contraction.
publicationBoundary: Do not promote ResearchTasteService, topology classifier, scheduler, query planner or default Agent prompt from HP0-HP2. Any TM4 revision must be evidence-scoped and reconciled against latest Computing main before landing.
